performance:allbirds.com.sql: SELECT platform, asset_type, count(*) AS assets, sum(impressions) AS impressions, sum(engagements) AS engagements, sum(clicks) AS clicks, sum(conversions) AS conversions FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.performance WHERE domain = 'allbirds.com' GROUP BY platform, asset_type ORDER BY engagements DESC

unsupported_claims:allbirds.com.sql: SELECT claim_kind, status, resolution_status, claim_text, recommendation, created_at FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.claim_outcome WHERE domain = 'allbirds.com' AND status IN ('unsupported', 'conflict') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12

audience_signals:allbirds.com:create.sql: CREATE REST SESSION TABLE fl_hn_liveallbirdsnews REQUEST (endpoint "https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=allbirds.com&tags=story&hitsPerPage=50", method "GET", http_encoding "URLENCODED", response_type "JSON", insecure_ssl "false") HEADER ("User-Agent" "Flusso/0.3 (evidence agent)") BODY ()

audience_signals:allbirds.com.sql: SELECT h.title, h.points, h.num_comments, substr(h.created_at, 1, 10) AS created, h.url FROM session.fl_hn_liveallbirdsnews LATERAL VIEW explode(hits) AS h WHERE h.url LIKE '%allbirds.com%' ORDER BY h.points DESC LIMIT 12

claim_risk:allbirds.com.sql: SELECT o.claim_kind, o.status, count(*) AS claims, sum(CASE WHEN o.resolution_status = 'repaired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repaired FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.claim_outcome o JOIN lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.campaign c ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.domain = 'allbirds.com' GROUP BY o.claim_kind, o.status ORDER BY claims DESC
